dynamic.control_discovery_intro_hint:
Home Assistant will temporarily change the collector's cloud endpoint to a local Home Assistant route. The selected cloud service will then send bounded test commands for this device. Home Assistant must capture and block the matching local writes before they reach the inverter; if that interception cannot be proven, the check stops. Afterward Home Assistant restores the previous endpoint. The vendor app may briefly lose live data during the switch; if automatic restoration cannot be confirmed, a recovery action remains available. Your login is used only for this check and is not saved.

⚠️ Before you continue, fully CLOSE the {cloud_app_label} mobile app so it does not compete with the check.

Confirm the temporary routing, test commands, and local interception below.

A local experimental register schema draft was created, but it will not override the built-in schema automatically.
dynamic.diagnostics_result_draft_rename_schema_n: Rename the draft to {name} if you want it to override the built-in schema automatically, then reload local metadata.
dynamic.control_discovery_provider_not_supported: Automatic control discovery is not available for {cloud_provider_label} yet. Local read-only support and support packages still work.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_empty_with_supp: The check has finished and the temporary cloud connection is closed. No controls were found to add this time. Download the support package so the developer can inspect what happened, or return to the menu.
dynamic.control_discovery_route_dropped: The temporary cloud connection ended before all capabilities could be checked. Home Assistant stopped safely and restored the collector connection.
dynamic.control_discovery_run_incomplete: The device check ended before all planned capabilities were tested.
dynamic.control_discovery_safety_stop: The safety check stopped the scan because a command may have bypassed the local learning route. Check the inverter before trying again.
dynamic.control_discovery_cloud_auth_failed: The cloud service rejected the login. Check the username and password.
dynamic.control_discovery_cloud_rate_limited: The cloud service temporarily limited requests. Wait a little and try again.
dynamic.control_discovery_cloud_unavailable: The cloud service could not provide the device data needed for this check.
dynamic.control_discovery_cloud_timeout: The cloud service did not respond in time. Try again later.
dynamic.control_discovery_cloud_network: Home Assistant could not reach the cloud service. Check its internet connection.
dynamic.control_discovery_cloud_unexpected: The cloud service returned an unexpected response.
dynamic.cloud_active_no_safe_controls: The selected cloud API did not expose any safe controls that could be checked for this device. Nothing was changed.
dynamic.control_discovery_failure_generic: Home Assistant stopped safely and restored the collector connection.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_failed: The check couldn't finish. {control_discovery_error} Try again, download the support package so the developer can inspect what happened, or return to the menu.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_notice_applied: ✓ The selected control(s) were added to Home Assistant.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_intro_none_sele: Discovery finished and the temporary cloud connection is closed. You did not turn on any of the discovered controls, so there is nothing to apply. Download the support package, or return to the menu.
dynamic.detection_tier_full_details: This model is in the built-in device catalog. Read sensors and controls will be added out of the box.
dynamic.detection_tier_partial_details:
The inverter family is recognized, but this exact model is not in the catalog yet. Base read sensors will be added; controls stay locked for safety.

Next step: after you finish here, open this integration and choose **Configure → Add controls (device learning)** to discover its controls and extra sensors.
dynamic.detection_tier_driver_details: The device was identified by its protocol driver. The standard sensor set for this driver will be added.
dynamic.detection_tier_unidentified_details:
The collector responds, but no inverter was detected through the selected driver/catalog path. This can mean the inverter is not connected, is powered off, uses an unsupported protocol, or only the collector is present.

No entry is created until the collector has a confirmed identity. Device learning is useful only after an inverter has actually been detected.

Next step: check the inverter connection, retry detection, then create a Support Archive if the device still cannot be identified.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_reads_only: Discovery finished and the temporary cloud connection is closed. {control_discovery_read_count} read sensor(s) were discovered. Apply them, download the support package, or return to the menu.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_reads_note: Plus {control_discovery_read_count} read sensor(s) were discovered and will be added on Apply.
dynamic.control_discovery_result_notice_applied_: ✓ The selected controls and {read_count} read sensor(s) were added to Home Assistant.
✓ {read_count} read sensor(s) were added to Home Assistant.
dynamic.scan_addable_next_select: Choose a device or address from the list. If it is missing, use **{refresh_action_label}** or **{manual_action_label}**.
dynamic.detection_tier_passive_callback_details:
This collector is already connected to Home Assistant. The setup wizard will add it as an incoming-session device; inverter detection will continue after the entry is created and the runtime owns this session.

If an inverter is connected, sensors and controls may appear a little later after the first successful runtime detection cycle.
dynamic.detection_tier_verified_callback_details:
The callback address **{callback_address}** and collector PN were verified. The incoming connection was observed from **{peer_ip}**, which may be a router or NAT address.

The inverter was not identified during setup. You can add the collector now; detection will continue after the entry takes ownership of the verified session.
dynamic.onboarding_confirm_inverter_pending_afte:
**Inverter**

After the device is added, Home Assistant will detect the connected inverter and create its entities automatically.
dynamic.manual_peer_address_note: The suggested address is only where the collector's connection came from. If the collector is behind a router, VPN, or port forwarding, this may be the router's address - enter the collector address that is reachable from Home Assistant.
dynamic.recovery_fail_silent_ambiguous: More than one collector connected at the same time. Leave only the collector you are adding online, then try again.
dynamic.recovery_fail_identity_mismatch: A different collector connected. Check the address and try again.
dynamic.recovery_fail_silent_probe_failed: The collector reconnected but did not confirm its identity.
dynamic.recovery_fail_silent_probe_unavailable: Home Assistant could not verify the collector's identity.
dynamic.recovery_fail_callback_timeout: The collector did not connect to Home Assistant in time.
dynamic.recovery_fail_inbound_timeout: The collector did not reconnect after the restart.
dynamic.recovery_fail_restart_unsupported: This collector cannot be verified by restarting it.
dynamic.recovery_fail_ownership_unavailable: The verified collector connection is no longer available.
dynamic.recovery_fail_generic: The collector connection could not be verified.
dynamic.recovery_fail_strong_identity_timeout: The collector's identity could not be confirmed in time.
dynamic.recovery_fail_restart_not_confirmed: The collector did not confirm the restart request.
dynamic.recovery_fail_disconnect_not_observed: The collector did not restart its connection in time.
dynamic.recovery_fail_reconnected_untrusted: The collector reconnected, but its identity could not be confirmed.
dynamic.transition_fail_session_unavailable: The collector is not connected right now, so the switch cannot be verified. Wait for the collector to connect, then try again.
dynamic.transition_fail_endpoint_required: The Home Assistant address to write into the collector is missing. Enter the address and port the collector can reach.
dynamic.transition_fail_callback_route_required: The collector address and the advertised Home Assistant callback address are required. Enter them and try again.
dynamic.transition_fail_rollback_unavailable: The integration manages the collector's endpoint, but no saved previous endpoint exists to hand control back to. The switch was not started.
dynamic.transition_fail_endpoint_write_failed: Writing the endpoint to the collector failed, so nothing was verified and the connection strategy was not changed. Try again.
dynamic.transition_fail_inbound_recovered_instea: The collector reconnected on its own instead of waiting for the callback, so on-demand operation could not be proven. Its endpoint still points at Home Assistant.
dynamic.transition_fail_already_running: Another connection switch is already in progress for this collector. Wait for it to finish.
dynamic.transition_fail_runtime_unavailable: The collector runtime is not loaded, so the switch cannot be verified right now. Try again after the integration finishes starting.
dynamic.transition_fail_not_required: The collector already uses this connection strategy. Nothing to change.
dynamic.transition_fail_recovered_after_restore: The collector reconnected on its own even though its endpoint was already handed back to the external target, so on-demand operation could not be proven. The connection keeps working; you can retry the switch.
dynamic.transition_fail_payload_forbidden: The switch request carried settings that only the verification itself may change. Nothing was modified.
dynamic.transition_fail_activation_incomplete: The on-demand connection was verified and saved, but Home Assistant could not finish loading the integration. The verification and the collector reconfiguration are not repeated -- Home Assistant just retries loading the already-proven callback configuration.
dynamic.transition_fail_suspend_failed: Home Assistant could not pause the running integration to repair the connection, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
dynamic.transition_fail_restore_failed: The repair was stopped without changing anything, but the previous configuration did not load again automatically. Reload the integration to bring it back.
dynamic.transition_fail_rollback_selection_requi: No cloud endpoint was chosen to hand the collector back to, so the switch was not started. Pick the previously saved endpoint, a catalog entry, or enter one manually.
dynamic.transition_fail_rollback_selection_inval: The chosen cloud endpoint could not be validated, so nothing was changed. Choose the endpoint again.
dynamic.transition_fail_rollback_persist_failed: The chosen cloud endpoint could not be saved, so it was NOT written to the collector and the connection strategy was not changed. Try again.
dynamic.transition_fail_rollback_registry_pn_req: This collector could not be identified well enough to durably save the chosen cloud endpoint, so nothing was written. Confirm the collector is connected and identified, then try again.
dynamic.transition_fail_rollback_selection_stale: The saved endpoint candidate changed after it was shown. Nothing was changed; review the current candidate and confirm it again.
dynamic.transition_fail_management_unavailable: The collector's current connection does not provide the endpoint write/apply operations required for this switch. Nothing was changed.
dynamic.transition_fail_inbound_rollback_persist: The current external endpoint could not be saved before redirecting the collector to Home Assistant, so the switch was not started.
dynamic.control_discovery_leaked: SAFETY STOP: the inverter dropped off the local proxy during the scan and a control command may have reached the real inverter. Check the inverter now, especially its output state. Do not repeat control discovery until the proxy-route problem is resolved.
dynamic.collector_endpoint_operation_busy: Another operation is currently changing this collector's connection (for example proxy capture, control discovery, or an endpoint action). Nothing was changed. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
